title: Window B Ag-C species-aware framework review and label-free registry candidate

framework_C_Ti_review.classification: recurrent framework first-shell contact; short/compressed local bond, not an Ag-registry pair
framework_C_Ti_review.cutoff_interpretation: Do not apply a uniform all-pair 1.75 A threshold to this framework pair.

pair_specific_contact_screen.interpretation: Empirical shortest labeled DFT distances in the same small-cluster motif; these are comparisons, not universal bond cutoffs.

duplicate_screen.near_duplicate_rule: Ag-only RMS <=0.15 A and framework RMS <=0.15 A after common Cartesian translation alignment; large-vacuum cluster coordinates are centered and compared without wrapping. Exact duplicate also requires matching cell and PBC.
